title: 第9章 芊纤的血和泪第10章 她要噬阳反被我吞噬
content_zh:
阴阳世界媲美现实宇宙，是个灵宠遍布的世界，没有智慧生命。
灵宠能认主，拥有专属天赋技能，是修炼者的强力助力。
灵宠认主难度极高，全凭机缘。
机缘总会留给有准备的人，我相信会有不少修炼者前来试炼，帮我找到时空信标。
刚进入试炼的人，都会被困在独立光球里，暂时无法离开。
能看到阴阳世界的景象，却没法触摸，就像处在不同维度。
不同光球间会隔绝感知，我能看清光球外的情况，是因为美女器灵在身边。
要等一天后试炼正式启动，光球才会消散。
“奇怪了，”我很快发现不对劲，“阴阳研究学院的女生怎么一个都没进来？”
“这些光球的位置是随机的，说不定她们在其他光球里。”馥蜜推测道。
香茹神色凝重，显然也察觉到了异常。
美女器灵正全力操控试炼入口，根本没法分心。
她满脸通红，香汗淋漓，显然维持入口开启的消耗极大。
想想也能理解，整个寰宇的试炼入口数量近乎无穷，每个入口都相当于跨维度传送通道，消耗自然难以估量。
突然眼前一闪，几百米外出现另一个光球。
里面有一位绿裙女子，身后跟着上千名白裙女子。
她们背对着我们，正打坐休息，等待试炼开始。
服饰如此统一，肯定不是学院的女生，大概率是其他宗门的。
我从“翌恒号”里拿出望远镜，看了一眼后，震惊当场。
她们的裙子上，都有圣女宫的标识！

我让香茹确认，她默默点了点头。
“她们为了追杀我加入试炼，难道都放弃了纯阴之体？”我满心疑惑。
香茹摇摇头：“不光是她们，我能感觉到，整个阴阳世界里到处都是圣女宫弟子的气息，而且越来越多，宗门里大半弟子都来了。”
她们怎么进来的？
我看向身边的美女器灵，难道她没能正确执行试炼准入规则？
这下彻底完蛋了。
本来是为了躲她们才来参加试炼，现在连这里都不安全，还能躲到哪里去？
我环顾四周，发现不远处有个直径3米的光圈。
美女器灵说过，这个世界有很多传送通道，连通着所有生命星球。
那个光圈，说不定就是一处传送通道。
试炼开启后，赶紧冲进通道，或许能躲开圣女宫弟子的追杀。
我让花舞、淑馨、涵馨进入“灵玉空间”，身边只留下金瑾、禾合、敏珉、莘馨、嘉兰、馥蜜和香茹。
我本想把她们都收入“纳生”方便行动，可婧露不建议这么做。
她解释，收入“纳生”时，会把肉身、灵体、非生命实物、非生命灵物，分别拆分到“纳生”“纳灵”“纳实”“纳虚”。
虽然能在“灵玉空间”里重新合并，但这个过程中，灵体和肉身会处于不同维度，导致两者的绑定关系短暂割裂。
长期来看，会影响肉身与灵体的契合度，不仅修炼天赋会下降，激活新灵体的概率也会降低。
不过美女器灵不受影响，可以直接收入“纳虚”。
婧露说，器灵属于“机械灵体”，是高等科技文明制造的灵体，兼容肉身、灵体、能量体、机械生命体等各种生命和物质形态。
……
试炼开始的瞬间，美女器灵还没苏醒。

我把她收入“纳虚”，抱起香茹，背起嘉兰，带着其他人冲向那个光圈。
content_en:
The Yin and Yang world is comparable to the real universe. It is a world full of spiritual pets and has no intelligent life.
Spiritual pets can recognize their masters and have exclusive talents and skills, which are a powerful assistance to practitioners.
It is extremely difficult for a spiritual pet to recognize its owner, and it all depends on chance.
Opportunities will always come to those who are prepared. I believe that many practitioners will come to try and help me find the space-time beacon.
Those who have just entered the trial will be trapped in an independent light ball and cannot leave for the time being.
I can see the scenes of the Yin and Yang world, but I can't touch them. It's like being in a different dimension.
Perception will be isolated between different light balls. I can clearly see the situation outside the light ball because the beautiful weapon spirit is by my side.
The light ball will not dissipate until the trial officially starts one day later.
"It's strange," I quickly realized something was wrong, "Why haven't any girls from the Institute of Yin-Yang Studies come in?"
"The positions of these light balls are random. Maybe they are in other light balls." Fumi speculated.
Xiangru looked solemn, obviously aware of the abnormality.
The beautiful weapon spirit is fully controlling the entrance to the trial and cannot be distracted at all.
Her face was flushed and she was dripping with sweat. It was obvious that she was spending a lot of time keeping her entrance open.
If you think about it, you can understand that the number of trial entrances in the entire universe is almost infinite. Each entrance is equivalent to an inter-dimensional transmission channel, and the consumption is naturally incalculable.
Suddenly, there was a flash before his eyes, and another ball of light appeared a few hundred meters away.
There was a woman in a green dress, followed by thousands of women in white dresses.
With their backs to us, they were meditating and resting, waiting for the trial to begin.
The clothes are so uniform, they are definitely not girls from the academy, but most likely from other sects.
I took out the telescope from the "Yiheng" and took a look. I was shocked on the spot.
Their skirts all have the logo of Sainte-Dermott!
I asked Xiangru to confirm, and she nodded silently.
"In order to hunt me down and join the trial, did they all give up their pure yin bodies?" I was full of doubts.
Xiangru shook her head: "It's not just them, I can feel that the entire Yin and Yang world is filled with the aura of the disciples of the Holy Maiden Palace, and there are more and more of them. Most of the disciples in the sect are here."
How did they get in?
I looked at the beautiful weapon spirit next to me. Did she fail to implement the trial access rules correctly?
This time it was completely over.
I originally came to take part in the trial to avoid them, but now even here is not safe, where else can I hide?
I looked around and found an aperture with a diameter of 3 meters not far away.
The beautiful Qi Ling said that there are many transmission channels in this world, connecting all living planets.
That aperture might be a transmission channel.
After the trial starts, rush into the passage and you may be able to avoid the pursuit of the disciples of the Holy Lady's Palace.
I let Hua Wu, Shu Xin, and Han Xin enter the "Spiritual Jade Space", leaving only Jin Jin, He He, Min Min, Xin Xin, Jialan, Fumi, and Xiang Ru beside me.
I originally wanted to put them all into the "Nasheng" for ease of movement, but Jinglu didn't recommend this.
She explained that when receiving "Na Sheng", the physical body, spiritual body, non-living physical objects, and non-living spiritual objects will be divided into "Na Sheng", "Na Spirit", "Na Real" and "Na Void" respectively.
Although they can be re-merged in the "Spiritual Jade Space", during this process, the spirit body and the physical body will be in different dimensions, causing the binding relationship between the two to be temporarily severed.
In the long run, it will affect the fit between the physical body and the spiritual body. Not only will the cultivation talent be reduced, but the probability of activating a new spiritual body will also be reduced.
However, the beautiful weapon spirit is not affected and can be directly paid into "Naxu".
Jing Lu said that the weapon spirit belongs to the "mechanical spirit body", which is a spirit body created by a high-tech civilization and is compatible with various life and material forms such as physical body, spiritual body, energy body, and mechanical life body.
…
The moment the trial began, the beautiful weapon spirit had not yet awakened.
I put her into "Naxu", picked up Xiangru, carried Jialan on my back, and rushed towards the aperture with the others.
